project.title: HeyPCB ESP32-S3 Sensors 1: Climate & Light
project.summary: 50 ESP32-S3 boards, one sensor each: temperature, humidity, pressure, CO2, gas, thermocouples and light. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
